3DMAX is a French esports organization founded in 2009 that in its original iteration hosted a number of Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, Counter-Strike: Source, and Counter-Strike rosters. After the organization was revived on May 16th 2018, 3DMAX signed NOBO, returning to Counter-Strike: Global Offensive scene until parting ways with the team in early 2019. 3DMAX then returned to host a Counter-Strike 2 roster, signing Looking4Org in November 2023.
